html:
Kition was an ancient city kingdom on the south coast of Cyprus, under today's Larnaca, settled by Mycenaean Greeks and then from about 850 BCE by Phoenicians from Tyre.

The Phoenicians built a great temple of Astarte on the ruins of earlier shrines and made Kition their main base on the island, trading copper and timber. It was one of about ten city kingdoms of Cyprus, some Greek and some Phoenician, that paid tribute in turn to Assyria, Egypt and Persia. Kition sided with Persia during the Greek revolts. After Alexander, Ptolemy I of Egypt ended its kingdom in 312 BCE. Its most famous son was the philosopher Zeno, founder of Stoicism.
sum: Kition was an ancient city kingdom on the south coast of Cyprus, under today's Larnaca, settled by Mycenaean Greeks and then from about 850 BCE by Phoenicians from Tyre.
